capabilities: automatically fix escaped Wiki-links when a file is opened
run a command (fix-wiki-links) to fix links manually
enable or disable automatic fixing in Settings
extras: Automatic fixing on file open is off by default and must be enabled in Settings.
motivation: The author found that Nextcloud Text breaks Obsidian's Wiki-links when files are opened there.
problem: Opening Markdown files in Nextcloud Text escapes Wiki-link brackets, leaving broken links in the vault.
summary: Link fixer that repairs Wiki-links ([[my link]] converted to escaped \[\[my link\]\]) broken by opening Markdown files in Nextcloud Text.
